# Full Port University

> Full Port University (FPU) is a beginner-friendly options and stock trading community on Discord. Members get real-time buy/trim/sell trade signals from a multi-analyst desk, a free 12-lesson options course, and weekly live teaching. A 14-day free trial is available through Whop.

Full Port University teaches options trading from zero. The core is a Discord server with live [BUY] to [TRIM] to [SELL] signals, structured beginner education, and daily community trading across stocks and options.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://fullportuniversity.com/): What FPU is, how the free trial works, and real member results.
- [How It Works](https://fullportuniversity.com/how-it-works): The Buy/Trim/Sell trade-signal system explained step by step.
- [Education](https://fullportuniversity.com/education): The free 12-lesson course, beginner series, and weekly live sessions.

## About
- Format: Discord community with live options and stock trade signals plus education
- Best for: complete beginners through intermediate options traders
- Signal system: [BUY] to open, [TRIM] to take partial profit, [SELL] to close
- Pricing: 14-day free trial via Whop; paid membership afterward

## Important disclosure
Full Port University is an educational community, not a registered investment advisor. All content is educational only and is not financial advice. Trading options and stocks involves substantial risk of loss; member and past results are not typical and are not a guarantee of future performance.
